ढ: ढ The aspirate of the preceding letter corresponding Dh: the use of this as an initial letter is very limited and several of the words in which it occurs can scarcely be regarded as pure Sanskrit.
ढ m. (-ढः) 	 1. A large drum. 	 2. A dog. 	 3. A dog's tail. 	 4. Sound. 	 5. A serpent.
ढक्क: ढक्क m. (-क्कः) 	 1. The city or district Dhacca or Dacca. 	 2. Coveting, disappearance. 	 f. (-क्का) A large or double drum, a Dhak.  E. ढक् imitative sound, and क what utters.
ढक्कारी: ढक्कारी f. (-री) The goddess TARINI, a Tantrika form of DURGA.
ढण्टी: ढण्टी f. (-ण्टी) वाक्यभेदे ढण्टीवाक्यस्वरूपा च ढकाराक्षररूपिणी ।
ढालिन्: ढालिन् m. (ली) A warrior armed with a shield, a shield-bearer.
ढुढ: ढुढ (इ) ढुढि Sautra root, (ढुण्ढति) To search, to seek. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
ढुण्ढन: ढुण्ढन n. (-नं) Seeking, investigating.  E. ढुढि to search, ल्युट्. aff.
ढुण्ढि: ढुण्ढि m. (-ण्ढिः) A name of GANESHA.  E. ढुढि to seek, कि aff.
ढुण्ढित: ढुण्ढित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sought, inquired.  E. ढुढि to seek, क्त aff.
ढोल: ढोल m. (-लः) A Dhol or large drum. दोलायमानो वाद्यमाने वाद्यभेदे ।
ढौक: ढौक (ऋ) ढौकृ r. 1st cl. (ढौकते) To go or move. प्रेरण गत्याञ्च भ्वा-आ-सक-सेट् ।
ढौकन: ढौकन n. (-नं) 	 1. Offering. 	 2. A present, a bribe.  E. ढौक् to go, ल्यु aff.
